metrics.node_timing_note: Eight largest previous-node sends, one observation per epoch/node start. Copy/poll are cumulative MCU maxima; prepare/check refer to previous physical batch. Same observation does not establish simultaneity or causality.

spi_batch_timing.note: Fields describe previous physical batch. Dedup by epoch/sequence//2; only batches containing target native RF/status are covered. Phase/mix are host observations, not causal attribution.

ack_batch_timing.note: Native half 1 metadata, categorized by same-batch WAV reply id/session. prepare/check describe prior iteration; check includes decode_pair and command processing, not IRQ-lock duration alone. No WAV ACK does not mean no command. Lifecycle reply counters include non-target profiles; timing groups only target RF. ACK-only and RF+ACK pairs lack coverage.

raw_chunk_ack_latency.note: Complete-frame socket read time versus entry to decoder event handling; correlated CHUNK ids/session, normal receiver validation unchanged

metrics.phase_caveat: Host observation boundaries, not MCU event timestamps. Sampled queue is a lower bound; cumulative peak remains acceptance gate. Send counters refer to previous node. Retune is not visible on this wire.
metrics.note: MCU queue/slack/send counters; send weighted once per complete node start. Cumulative MCU peak includes startup.
